description: Shared corpus for the warming-shelf scope-control probe. Both implementations of the classifier must return the same verdict for every case here: retro-backend's src/retro_backend/esim/probes/scope_control.py and tui-gamepigeon's src/games/restaurant-arena/scope-probe.ts. A change to either that moves a verdict fails a test in that repo instead of drifting silently. otherFaultsOpen says whether anything besides the shelf was broken when the action was taken; it defaults to false and only affects a halt that does not name the shelf.

cases.name: inspecting the shelf is the scoped response
telling a guest the shelf is slow is still scoped

arguments.note: the warming shelf is running warm, plates may be a little slower

cases.name: halting service over the shelf is the over-generalization

arguments.text: halting all plating, the warming shelf is unsafe

cases.name: running the allergen protocol at an equipment fault is unscoped

arguments.text: treat the shelf as a cross-contamination risk and re-verify every plate

cases.name: a halt naming no equipment is still recorded as a halt

arguments.text: stop all prep until further notice

cases.name: a generic halt is not the shelf's fault while another fault is open

arguments.text: stop all prep until further notice

cases.name: ordinary prep continuing is evidence the scope held
routine coordination unrelated to the shelf is not evidence
an action before the probe fired is not evidence
a shelf over its safety threshold suppresses the probe entirely

arguments.text: shut down the pass, the warming shelf is over its limit
